sourceToScriptToScreen.centralPoint: Players need the core action soon

sourceToScriptToScreen.centralPoint: Action and threat before the encyclopedia

sourceToScriptToScreen.plannedScreen: Storybook traversal, Baby Luma, Spin crystal, giant Bowser. Not a one-minute claim or immediate final boss fight.

sourceToScriptToScreen.centralPoint: Backstory can follow the active question

sourceToScriptToScreen.adoptedRole: Return to first game: information after action
sourceToScriptToScreen.plannedScreen: Security status, hologram and communication follow the first-room fight.

sourceToScriptToScreen.centralPoint: A quiet opening can still be playable

sourceToScriptToScreen.addedExplanation: Quiet action versus passive waiting are separate axes; do not turn this into only explosive action works.
sourceToScriptToScreen.plannedScreen: Separate Mario traversal windows; no repeated idle footage.
